writeup: Kohler's Purist Rite-Temp bath and shower trim kit in Vibrant Polished Nickel is $539.99 new at Woot. It includes the cross handle, 35-degree spout, 2.5 gpm showerhead with arm and flange, and the faceplate with push-button diverter. SupplyHouse sells it for $1,161.37. The Rite-Temp valve isn't included.
